protocol: Final same-process development regression, 24 HTTP turns including six repeated requests. Local Gemma4 E4B CPU; web startup readiness/precalculation excluded from resident request time and reported separately. Worker stays running. No independent accuracy claim; label C/P/I separately. Repeat samples are warm source/ranker caches, not Gemma inference speed.
